content.value_statement: API security reviews can miss authentication, authorization, and validation gaps. This skill guides structured REST and GraphQL testing from discovery to reporting.
actual_capabilities: Organizes API discovery, authentication, authorization, input validation, rate limiting, GraphQL, and error handling checks.
Provides phase-based prompts for invoking related security testing skills.
Defines an API security checklist for common review coverage.
Includes quality gates for documentation, remediation, and final reporting.
Supports REST and GraphQL review planning for authorized security work.
limitations: Requires documented authorization and scope before testing any API.
Does not run scanners or validate findings without other tools.
Does not replace expert review for production security decisions.
Depends on accurate API documentation, credentials, and test environment access.

use_cases.title: Plan an API Security Review
use_cases.description: Create a phased checklist for testing authentication, authorization, validation, rate limits, and error handling.

use_cases.title: Prepare Pre-Release API Testing
use_cases.description: Use the workflow to confirm common API controls before a new REST or GraphQL release.

use_cases.title: Structure Authorized Bug Bounty Work
use_cases.description: Organize endpoint discovery and vulnerability testing within approved program scope.

prompt_templates.title: Begin API Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan an authorized API security review for this service. Include discovery, authentication, authorization, input validation, rate limiting, and reporting steps.

prompt_templates.title: Check Authentication Controls
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my API authentication design. Identify tests for API keys, JWTs, OAuth flows, token expiration, and refresh token handling.

prompt_templates.title: Test Authorization Boundaries
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an authorization test plan for these endpoints. Cover object-level access, function-level access, roles, privilege escalation, and tenant isolation.

prompt_templates.title: Build Full API Assessment Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a complete authorized REST and GraphQL API security assessment plan. Include scope assumptions, test phases, evidence to collect, risk ranking, and remediation reporting.

output_examples.input: I need to review a new customer API before release.
output_examples.output: A phased review plan covering endpoint discovery, authentication checks, authorization tests, input validation, rate limiting, error handling, and reporting gates.

output_examples.input: Our GraphQL API allows complex nested queries.
output_examples.output: A GraphQL testing checklist focused on introspection, query depth, query complexity, batching, field suggestions, and denial-of-service controls.

output_examples.input: I found inconsistent role checks between endpoints.
output_examples.output: An authorization-focused test plan with object access cases, role comparisons, tenant isolation checks, evidence notes, and remediation priorities.

best_practices: Confirm written authorization, test scope, and rate limits before any active testing.
Use separate test accounts for each role, tenant, and permission boundary.
Record evidence, expected behavior, actual behavior, and remediation guidance for each finding.
anti_patterns: Testing production APIs without explicit permission or a defined scope.
Treating scanner output as confirmed risk without manual validation.
Skipping authorization checks because authentication appears strong.

faq.question: Does this skill run security scanners?
faq.answer: No. It provides a structured workflow and prompts for related skills or tools.

faq.question: Can I use it for GraphQL APIs?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes GraphQL checks for introspection, query depth, complexity, batching, and field suggestions.

faq.question: Is this only for bug bounty testing?
faq.answer: No. It also supports internal security reviews, pre-release checks, and compliance preparation.

faq.question: What inputs improve the result?
faq.answer: Provide API documentation, endpoint lists, roles, credentials for test accounts, allowed scope, and target environment details.

faq.question: Does it replace a penetration test?
faq.answer: No. It helps structure testing, but expert validation is still required for high-risk systems.

faq.question: How should findings be reported?
faq.answer: Include affected endpoints, reproduction steps, impact, evidence, risk rating, and recommended remediation.
